A release for the version that every package of the family carries and the new range of its dependencies, with nothing changed in this package.
([#43](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/43))

### Packaging

- Depends on `@umber-style/core` `^0.5.0` (it was `^0.4.0`).
